description: Source code for PwmTester, a tool to measure PWM generation quality in the rusEfi engine control system. Contains functions to initialize PWM tests, schedule output signals, and manage PWM test execution.

methods.name: startPwmTest
methods.description: Initializes and starts PWM test signals on multiple injectors and a warning LED at specified frequency.

methods.name: testCallback
methods.description: Schedules multiple output signals to occur shortly after invocation, then reschedules itself for repeated testing.

methods.name: initPwmTester
methods.description: Initializes PWM testing environment, sets up console command, and starts initial PWM test.
